document.about: Cree Lighting Noctura Series B wall-mount install guide (EN/ES/FR, 9 pages). Each language's wiring page sets its electrical connections as six lettered steps, `a.` to `f.`, each wrapped over a line or two, beside the wiring diagram.

notes: #244: lettered steps never formed a list: each read as a paragraph opening with its letter.

checks.issue: #244: the English wiring step `a.` was a paragraph, not a list's item.

element.text: a. For 120/277/347V connect the black fixture lead to the voltage supply or Hot 1 (for 208/240/480V wiring).

checks.issue: #244: the English wiring step `f.` was a paragraph, not a list's item.

element.text: f. NOTE: For dimming connections, use Class 1 wiring methods only.

checks.issue: #244: the Spanish wiring step `a.` was a paragraph, not a list's item.

element.text: a. Para 120 V /277 V /347 V, conecte el cable negro de la luminaria a la posición de alimentación de voltaje o energizado 1 (para cableado de 208 V /240 V /480 V).

checks.issue: #244: the Spanish wiring step `f.` was a paragraph, not a list's item.

element.text: f. NOTA: Para conexiones de atenuación, use métodos de cableado de clase 1 únicamente.

checks.issue: #244: the French wiring step `a.` was a paragraph, not a list's item.

element.text: a. Pour 120 /277 /347 V connectez le fil noir du luminaire à la position d’alimentation ou Hot 1 (pour câblage 208 / 240/ 480 V).

checks.issue: #244: the French wiring step `f.` was a paragraph, not a list's item.

element.text: f. REMARQUE : Pour les connexions avec gradation, utilisez uniquement des méthodes de câblage de classe 1.
